headline: PSEi regains ground after steep sell-off
summary: The PSEi rose 0.87% to close at 5,353.07 after touching an intraday high of 5,419.49, rebounding from a steep sell-off the previous week. Trading remained light and the index failed to hold above 5,400.
why: The PSEi is the benchmark index of the Philippine Stock Exchange, tracking the country's largest listed companies and serving as a gauge of local market sentiment.
